title: CRA gap check input
description: Give an SBOM and a few facts about the product. The Actor returns a 14-check EU Cyber Resilience Act gap report. Add a Grype scan to get the vulnerability checks; set sealed to get a signed copy that can be verified later.

productName.title: Product name
productName.description: Name of the product the SBOM describes, for example my-app. Required. It is compared with the SBOM's top-level component and printed in the report as declared.
productName.sectionDescription: Declared by you and not verified. They appear in the report as declared.

productVersion.title: Product version
productVersion.description: Version of the product the SBOM describes, for example 1.2.0. Optional. Compared with the SBOM's top-level component version.

vendor.title: Manufacturer
vendor.description: Name of the manufacturer, for example Example Ltd. Optional. Printed as declared and not verified.

supportPeriodEnd.title: Support period end
supportPeriodEnd.description: Last day you commit to ship security updates, written YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2031-06-30. Optional. A date in the past gives a warning.

securityContact.title: Security contact
securityContact.description: Where people report vulnerabilities: an email address or an https URL. Optional. Without a security.txt or SECURITY.md URL this is only recorded as declared, so the disclosure check stays at warn.

securityTxtUrl.title: security.txt URL
securityTxtUrl.description: https URL of the product's RFC 9116 security.txt. Optional. It is downloaded and checked for a Contact field and an Expires date. Public hosts only, no port, max 256 KiB.

securityPolicyUrl.title: Security policy URL
securityPolicyUrl.description: https URL of the product's SECURITY.md as raw text. Optional. It is downloaded and checked for a way to report a vulnerability. Public hosts only, no port, max 256 KiB.

sbomUrl.title: SBOM URL
sbomUrl.description: https URL of the SBOM as CycloneDX JSON or SPDX 2.x JSON, max 15 MiB. Give this or sbomJson, not both. Public hosts only, no port.
sbomUrl.sectionDescription: Exactly one of the URL or the pasted JSON.

sbomJson.title: SBOM (pasted JSON)
sbomJson.description: The SBOM itself as a JSON object (CycloneDX or SPDX 2.x), max 15 MiB. Give this or sbomUrl, not both.

grypeUrl.title: Grype result URL
grypeUrl.description: https URL of a vulnerability scan: the JSON output of grype -o json, max 15 MiB. Optional. Without a scan, the vulnerability checks say that no scan ran. Give this or grypeJson, not both.
grypeUrl.sectionDescription: At most one of the URL or the pasted JSON.

grypeJson.title: Grype result (pasted JSON)
grypeJson.description: The output of grype -o json as a JSON object. Optional. Give this or grypeUrl, not both.

sealed.title: Sealed report
sealed.description: Set to true to also receive cra-evidence-sealed.json, a signed copy of the report in ProofLog's evidence format. Anyone with the publisher's public key can later check that the report was not altered. The run is then billed as a sealed report instead of a plain one. Default false.
sealed.sectionDescription: Adds a signed file to the key-value store. See the Actor README for how to verify it.
